description: This file defines the UpgraderCompleteController class in the OrangeHRM installer module, responsible for managing the 'upgrader complete' view within the upgrade process. It extends an abstract Vue controller, sets up a Vue component with product version info, updates application state, and logs status information.

classes.name: UpgraderCompleteController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the 'upgrader complete' view in the upgrade process, extending the abstract Vue controller and configuring the onboarding screen.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating a Vue component, setting product version as a property, updating application state to indicate the current screen, and logging the upgrade status.
